Title: targeting a vamp in torpor with a D action

Messages.Author: nutter
Messages.Body:
This is probably just my inept reading of the rules rather than a lack
of ruling but I can't find an answer... Can you target a vampire in
torpor with a D action? Specifically, could I use Enkidu's rush
special to enter combat with a torpored vamp?

relevant text - Enkidu can enter combat with any minion as a (D)
action

There is no mention made of ready or otherwise so I think I probably
can, but want to confirm.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
nutter wrote:
> This is probably just my inept reading of the rules rather than a lack
> of ruling but I can't find an answer... Can you target a vampire in
> torpor with a D action?

Sure. Diablerie, for example.

> Specifically, could I use Enkidu's rush
> special to enter combat with a torpored vamp?
>
> relevant text - Enkidu can enter combat with any minion as a (D)
> action
>
> There is no mention made of ready or otherwise so I think I probably
> can, but want to confirm.

No. Only ready minions can enter combat, so only ready minions can be the target
of an "enter combat" action.
